title: GFN & Technology Models Library (2025–2035)
description: Library of four interrelated computational models of the Global Financial Network (GFN), cascading defaults, technology index and technological lag with focus on Russia, USA and China (horizon 2025–2035). Includes Monte-Carlo + Numba optimization, Gai–Kapadia cascade mechanism, SBS twin-simulation and endogenous technological dynamics (tech_centrality, tech_dependence, tech_lag).
